title: scoring server readiness wait: timeout error must report the last ping failure and chain it as __cause__
answers: Why did my model serving / scoring server fail with 'was not ready' and no reason?
Scoring server timed out during startup; how do I see whether it refused connections or returned an HTTP error?
Where is the wait for the MLflow scoring server to become ready implemented and what does its timeout message contain?
body:
Path: Waits for a launched MLflow scoring (model) server to answer its ping/health endpoint before a client sends invoke or version requests; used when starting a local model server with a timeout and optional server subprocess. Chokepoint: mlflow/pyfunc/scoring_server/client.py:ScoringServerClient.wait_server_ready.
Rule: Keep the exception from the last failed self.ping() call and, on timeout, raise RuntimeError with a message containing the server URL (self.url_prefix), elapsed seconds, configured timeout, the server PID when scoring_server_proc is given, and the last ping error as '<ExceptionType>: <message>'. Raise with 'from last_error' so the original exception is kept as __cause__. Polling interval, timeout value and the early-exit check on scoring_server_proc.poll() are unchanged.
Symptom: CI and users got a bare 'Wait scoring server ready timeout.' with no URL, timing or underlying error, so it was impossible to tell connection refused from an HTTP error response from a slow start.
Constraints: Applies to the timeout branch only. The early-exit path (process returned a code before timeout) still raises its own 'Server process already exit with returncode' RuntimeError without the ping diagnostics. Only the most recent ping exception is kept, not a history. The exception class is still RuntimeError; callers that match on the old message text will not match the new one.
applies: Scoring server / model server client readiness waiting in mlflow/pyfunc/scoring_server; not general HTTP retry logic.
says: Model serving startup times out with a blank error providing no failure details.
Local model server readiness timeout does not show the underlying connection or response error.
Include the server URL and last health check error when model startup times out.
Model deployment times out waiting for the server without explaining why it failed.
Cannot tell whether local model serving refused connections or failed to start up.
search: In mlflow/pyfunc/scoring_server/client.py:ScoringServerClient.wait_server_ready, timeout waiting for scoring server readiness must raise a RuntimeError chaining the last ping exception as __cause__. The timeout error message must report the server URL prefix, elapsed seconds, configured timeout, server PID if a subprocess was provided, and the last ping failure formatted as '<ExceptionType>: <message>'. Polling intervals, timeout thresholds, and the early process exit RuntimeError remain unchanged. Applies exclusively to the timeout branch in scoring server readiness waiting, retaining only the most recent ping error.
